solution.title: Cloud-First Autopilot Zero-Touch Provisioning (Entra Join, Optional Later Domain Join)

products.name: Cloud-First Autopilot Zero-Touch Provisioning (Entra Join, Optional Later Domain Join) — Commercial
products.short_description: A near zero-touch cloud-first provisioning model — Entra join + Windows Autopilot so devices provision on power-on, with domain join added later only if truly required — so technicians do almost nothing. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Power on, walk away — provision Windows cloud-first with Autopilot, domain-join only if you must

Hybrid provisioning drags: technicians babysit each build, juggle domain join, and handle too much by hand. The modern path is cloud-first — Entra join + Windows Autopilot so a device provisions itself the moment it's powered on, with domain join added afterward only if a specific app or resource truly requires it. This solution delivers that near zero-touch model: Autopilot profiles, the Enrollment Status Page, app/policy delivery at provisioning, and a clean decision path for the rare case that still needs on-prem domain join — so technicians do almost nothing.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the cloud-first provisioning model (Entra join + Autopilot), why it beats hybrid-by-default, the zero-touch experience (ESP, app/policy at enrollment), and the decision criteria for adding domain join later only when required.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, hardware-hash/registration path, the Enrollment Status Page, app/baseline set, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: register devices, build the Autopilot deployment profile (Entra join), configure the Enrollment Status Page and provisioning-time apps/policies, validate the zero-touch flow, define the optional later-domain-join path, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Autopilot/enrollment readiness discovery, provisioning/enrollment validation, a provisioning-success and technician-touch report, safe remediation of failed provisioning, and an Autopilot target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Windows devices that provision themselves on power-on — Entra-joined via Autopilot with apps and policy applied at enrollment, domain join only where truly required — cutting technician effort to almost nothing, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CFAP-Discovery.ps1 — Autopilot / enrollment readiness discovery for Cloud-First Autopilot
    • CFAP-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation of failed cloud-first Autopilot provisioning
    • CFAP-Report.ps1 — Provisioning-success and technician-touch report for Cloud-First Autopilot
    • CFAP-Set-AutopilotTargeting.ps1 — Build/maintain the dynamic Autopilot target group and confirm
    • CFAP-Validation.ps1 — Per-device provisioning / enrollment validation for Cloud-First Autopilot

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
